display.title: Ascension I: Reach Tier 2
display.subtitle: 500 tokens, or 80% of the T1 boss-rush
description: The first ascension. However you got here (banked tokens or boss-rush),
the Codex recognizes your growth and opens Tier 2.
This quest completes the moment the Codex engine grants you the Tier 2
stage. You do not submit anything here; the milestone tracks the
Tier 2 unlocks the mid-tier dimensions (the Twilight Forest and Blue
Skies' Everbright and Everdawn) and Thermal-tier engineering.

engine_grants_t2.title: Be granted the Tier 2 stage by the Codex
